title: The Table That Needed Two Lifters
youtube_title: The Table That Needed Two Lifters | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Teamwork is letting each person keep the part they do best.
summary: At a bakery kitchen before the early table, a table that needed two lifters and a count of three will go wrong if one person rushes. Tamsin and Pilar split it into two slow jobs, while Ms. Okonkwo only offers a count or a name for the knot they need. They finish together.
